description: Regenerate one scene's image. With a direction and mode iterate (default when a keyframe exists) the current image is edited; mode fresh creates a new image from the scene description (plus direction). Run the preview step afterwards to update the video.

direction.description: What to change, e.g. "golden-hour light, add the storefront sign"

project.description: Project id, 8-character id prefix, or exact project name

name: d2v_regenerate_keyframe
title: Regenerate keyframe
